caption: The drawing depicts a round, lidded ceramic container and its matching lid, both rendered against a plain, light beige background. The container and lid are a rich reddish-brown color with a glossy appearance. Decorative yellow and green patterns, including stylized leaves, lines, and dots, are present on both the lid and the body of the container. The container is shown with its lid placed slightly above it, giving a clear view of both components. The lid features a small knob in the center for handling and is ornamented with curving designs and small floral elements. The body of the container has similar decorative patterns that wrap around the surface, coordinating with the motifs on the lid. There are no other objects or details in the composition.
title: Pa. German Jar with Cover
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
